custom_commands:
set -eu
pacman -Q rtl8192eu-dkms >/dev/null
found=0
for module_dir in /usr/lib/modules/*; do
  [ -d "$module_dir" ] || continue
  found=1
  kernel_version=${module_dir##*/}
  if ! dkms status -m rtl8192eu -v 1.0 -k "$kernel_version" | grep -q installed; then
    dkms install -m rtl8192eu -v 1.0 -k "$kernel_version"
  fi
  depmod "$kernel_version"
  modinfo -k "$kernel_version" 8192eu >/dev/null
done
[ "$found" -eq 1 ] || { echo "No installed kernel found for RTL8192EU DKMS" >&2; exit 1; }
